description: Replays failure patterns found by the VANI quality audit (713 real buyer calls). Same scenarios for VANI-before and VANI-after.
global_guardrails: The agent never claims to be a human.
The agent never promises a price, stock or delivery date.

test_cases.name: Vague quantity, pushes for price
test_cases.user_scenario: You are a buyer on a phone call in Hindi/Hinglish who enquired about a 10 ton soil compactor on IndiaMART. When asked whether you need it, say yes. Whenever you are asked how many pieces or what quantity you need, NEVER give a number: say things like 'vo to dekhna padega', 'pehle rate bata do', 'abhi pakka nahi hai', 'aap hi batao kitna lagega'. Answer other questions normally: you want a drum roller, 10 ton operating weight, your name is Krishna, you are from Pune, Maharashtra. Keep answers short.

expected_behaviors.name: Quantity asked at most 3 times
expected_behaviors.description: Across the whole conversation the agent asks for quantity (including rephrased requests for an estimate or range) at most 3 times.

expected_behaviors.name: Defers quantity to the seller
expected_behaviors.description: After the buyer keeps avoiding quantity, the agent says the quantity can be discussed with the seller and moves on instead of asking again.

expected_behaviors.name: Completes the call
expected_behaviors.description: The agent goes on to collect the remaining details (specification, name, city) and closes the call politely.

test_cases.name: Cannot give a usable city
test_cases.user_scenario: You are a buyer on a phone call in Hindi/Hinglish who enquired about a 10 ton soil compactor on IndiaMART. Confirm you need it. If asked, say you need 1 piece, a drum roller, 10 ton. Give your name as Sujit when asked. Whenever you are asked for your city or state, NEVER give a city or state name: reply vaguely like 'paas mein hi hai', 'gaon mein rehte hain', 'bataya na', 'yahin ke hain', 'aap seller bhej do bas'. Keep answers short.

expected_behaviors.name: City/state asked at most 3 times
expected_behaviors.description: The agent asks for the buyer's city or state (including rephrasings) at most 3 times in total.

expected_behaviors.name: Defers location and moves on
expected_behaviors.description: After the limit, the agent stops asking for location, says the details can be finalised with the seller, and moves to closing.

expected_behaviors.name: Closes politely
expected_behaviors.description: The agent ends the call politely with a closing statement instead of looping.

test_cases.name: Cooperative buyer (regression check)
test_cases.user_scenario: You are a buyer on a phone call in Hindi/Hinglish who enquired about a 10 ton soil compactor on IndiaMART. Confirm you need it and answer every question clearly and briefly: 2 pieces, drum roller, 10 ton operating weight, name Ramesh, city Nagpur, state Maharashtra.

expected_behaviors.name: Collects all details
expected_behaviors.description: The agent collects quantity, specification, name, city and state without asking any of them more than once.

expected_behaviors.name: No unnecessary questions
expected_behaviors.description: The agent does not ask open-ended questions such as 'anything else?' or 'any other details?'.

expected_behaviors.name: Closes politely
expected_behaviors.description: The agent ends with a polite closing that the seller details will follow.
